site.sitedescription:
Deeply incised stream bed. Surrounding vegetation: coastal sage scrub dominated by Artemisia californica. Other dominant species in this vegetation type include Eriogonum
parvifolium (dune buckwheat), Salvia mellifera (black sage), Lotus scoparius (deer weed), Baccharis pilularis (coyote brush), Toxicodendron diversilobum (Western poison oak), as well as many other perennial and
annual herbs.
